 5. Many devotees have images of the Enlightened Beings they worship in their homes.
 Below are pictures of some of those Enlightened Beings. Write their names in the
 spaces provided. (3 marks)
 Enlightened Beings Name

 7. The lives of Enlightened Beings are inspirational for many years, even after they have
 passed on. Give two common teachings of the Enlightened Beings, that are still
 applicable today. (2 marks)
 a. ________________________________________________________
 b. ________________________________________________________
 8. The Sikhs worship their Scripture as a Living Guru. Tick the statement that describes
 the teaching Sikhs follow from the Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji. (1 mark)
 Sharing ten percent of one’s earnings to help less fortunate in the society.
 Monkhood is the only way to one’s salvation.
 The devotees are encouraged to practice Brahmacharya.
 9. After reading the Ramayana, Naresh decided to go to the Shri Hanuman Mandir and

 offer to the deity at the Mandir.
 (2 marks)

 10. The following statements gives a description of a Scripture: It
 i. has detailed life histories of twenty-four great reformers.
 ii. has the twenty fourth reformer’s last sermons recorded in it.
 iii. read during the celebration of the eight days of fasting on water.
 The Scripture described above is (1 mark)
 Veda Kalpasutra Panchasilla

 11. According to the historical events recorded in the scriptures, when Sitaji was sent off to
 live in the Aashram of Rishi Valmiki, she gave birth to her two sons who were called
 ________________________ and __________________________. (2 marks)

 (1 mark)
 13. Lord Buddha taught his followers to respect the gift of life without hurting any living
 being. The principle that teaches this is _________________________________.
 (1 mark)
 14. Ruth visited her friend Nalini and saw the whole family doing pooja. She saw her
 friend preparing Aarti thaali. Nalini explained to her that the special plate has items
 that are used during worship. Which one of the following items is not used?
 (1 mark)
 i. Menthol crystals
 ii. Incense stick
 iii. Lit up candle

 17. Some religious organizations came forward to help Kenyans who had been affected by
 drought by donating basic needs to them. This act of Sadachaar demonstrated by
 religious organizations is ______________________. (1 mark)
 18. Friendship is a valued relationships in the world. Enlightened beings also emphasize on
 the need of true friendships. Which pair from the options given below demonstrated
 true friendship.
 (1 mark)
 Shri Krishna and Sudama
 Lord Buddha and King Ashoka
 Sri Guru Nanak Devji and Bhai
 Lehnaji

 Team B. The captain of Team A congratulated Team B and invited them that evening
 to a party to celebrate Team B’s victory. The Sadachaar demonstrated by Team A is
 _______________________________________________________________. (1 mark)

 that takes place in the Mandir during the celebration of Mahashivtratri? (1 mark)
